tasks.description: Review every original source assumption and complete domain requirement before delivery. A completed calculation with failed pressure,velocity or continuity checks must block this dependent review path. Preserve total-pressure versus flow/velocity units,raw branch/node results and unresolved physical routing,fan operating point,acoustics,product and code applicability.

requirements.quote: Run the existing prescribed level constant-density rectangular air-tree calculator on rectangular-air/project.json through the selected module provider. Preserve declared flows,internal dimensions,route lengths,roughness,K,source total pressure and all applicability assumptions;no saved geometry or selected fan is inferred.
